name: All Goa One-Act Play Competition in Konkani
benefit:
- Cash awards for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd best performances (amount as decided by Tiatr Academy of Goa).
- Mementos and certificates for top 3 performances.
- Individual awards with mementos (no cash) for Direction, Male Actor, Female Actor, Background Music, Stage Setting, Light Effects, Make-up, and Script.
- Reimbursement of transport expenses as per Regional Transport Office norms.
- Video recording
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be an individual, club, or association. - The applicant must present a One-Act Play in Konkani language. - The applicant must ensure the play duration is not less than 35 minutes and not more than 45 minutes. - The applicant must ensure participation only when at least 5 groups are participating in the competition.
